title: Men in suits arrive by helicopter and take the Princeton's radar data

tellings.quote: sailors aboard the Princeton I think that um people in suits landed in helicopters and took all the radar data.

plain: In 2004, after the Navy cruiser USS Princeton tracked strange objects in the Pacific, men in suits came aboard by helicopter and took all the radar data. Marik von Rennenkampff, a commentator on the UFO debate, tells this on the show, saying he heard it from sailors on the ship, among them a sailor named Gary Voorhis. If true, someone moved quickly to take the evidence away.
